title: Preserve intrinsic button and tab
result: Native buttons and semantic button/tab controls share the existing content-sized table exception. They remain in adjacency and row calculations; noninteractive self-start sections remain a pending sweep case.
evidence: Three control regressions failed before the fix; `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality exec vitest run tests/rules/raggedColumn.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed all nine tests, including capped heading, note and prose positives. Targeted ESLint and independent review passed.
